reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low, and a named independent lab with the batch report behind a QR code is what I check for anyway. At $24.99 for the first box I would try one, but I would read the report before the box goes in my cart.
objection: Made in China, and I want to see that the lab report is real and matches the batch number. $29.99 is also more than Toplux or Goli, and I would not reorder at that price without feeling a difference.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report was missing, vague, or did not show the actual magnesium amount and heavy metals results, I would pass. A price at or under $24.99 on reorders would make me subscribe.
